batch: b — Home Command Center JRN-51..60 + retest of iteration_6 failures
summary: The backend bundle is correct: all 7 API tests pass. Every drill figure equals its list API for Today, Month and FY. Role widgets are enforced on the server, and Sales gets no money data. The browser found 4 failures. (1) HIGH: after a logout and login in the same tab, the next user sees the previous user's cached Home. Sales logging in after the Owner sees all 11 owner widgets with money. (2) Collections and Bills-raised (demands) drill-downs have no 'Filtered from Home · Clear' chip. (3) When there is no inflow, 'Next 30 days inflow' still shows bare ₹0 / 0 rows under its empty sentence. (4) First widget appears about 1.35 s after a warm login; the target is 1.0 s or less. Both iteration_6 failures are fixed: the Roznamcha refund row and line now add up, and axe finds 0 contrast violations.

bugs.criterion: JRN-54 Role defaults enforced by the server
bugs.title: Logout does not clear the client cache: the next user in the same tab sees the previous user's Home, including money
bugs.evidence: Check home-role-defaults, leak probe (2 consistent runs). admin@kkt.in login → Home → user-menu → menu-logout → sales@kkt.in login in the same tab, no reload. The Home grid then shows money_today, due_vs_received, ageing, call_today, inflow_30, next_milestone, inventory, flat_status, construction, pipeline, attention, with 'Money today ₹4.1 L … Cash ₹2.8 L … Overdue by age ₹7.43 Cr' (screenshot home-role-defaults-leak-probe.png). The first run hit the same issue the other way: Sales → logout → accounts@kkt.in, and Accounts saw Sales' layout and data ('Call today: No overdue customers', Sales pipeline, Inventory with no Booked state). The server is correct: GET /api/home/bundle as sales returns only call_today/inventory/flat_status/pipeline with no money keys (test_tscheck_home_command_center::test_role_defaults_server_enforced passed). After a full page reload, every role sees its correct default. Cause seen in code: AuthContext.logout clears tokens and the user, but does not clear the react-query/useFetch cache ('/home/bundle?period=month' key), and the module-level customizeOpened flag survives.

Every drill's figure matches its list: ageing 0-30 → 'In band 0-30' ₹49.9 L, 10; money-today → collections ₹4.1 L / ₹2.8 L / ₹91,876; month due → ₹3,48,20,760; inflow → ₹1,33,18,010; stale → 4; holds → 1 record; leads → 6; follow-ups → 1. Chip present: ageing, holds, pipeline-leads, followups, inventory cell. Chip missing: /reports/collections-v2?from_date=2026-11-16&to_date=2026-11-16, /demands?basis=due&date_from=2026-11-01&date_to=2026-11-30, /demands?basis=due&date_from=2026-11-17&date_to=2026-12-16, /demands?stale_days=30. Only Reports (outstanding), Leads, Bookings and FlatsTable import DrillFilterChip. Also, on the collections drill the period pills highlight 'FY' while the range reads 16 Nov–16 Nov. The backend is healthy: every drill api equals its figure (test_every_drill_equals_its_list, today/month/fy, passed).

bugs.criterion: JRN-59 + JRN-60 Isolation and speed, both themes, phone
bugs.title: Warm login → first widget ≈1.35 s (target ≤1.0 s)
bugs.evidence: Check home-isolation-speed-phone, 2 runs of 5 warm logins on the preview URL. First run [first, all] ms: [1352,1358],[1359,1365],[1347,1352],[1855,1861],[1353,1358]. Second run: [1350,1356],[835,841],[1349,1354],[1352,1358],[1354,1359]. Median first widget 1350 ms (fails ≤1000). Median all widgets 1356 ms (passes ≤1800). Backend is fast: curl localhost:8001 POST /api/auth/login 0.24 s, GET /api/home/bundle ~5 ms. The steady ~1.35 s, with one 835 ms run, suggests a fixed client-side delay after login (redirect, auth/me, or a transition) rather than server time. The other parts of this criterion passed: one-widget failure isolation, Retry, Night theme, 390×844 with 0 px horizontal scroll (Night and Light), and 0 console errors.
